title: [3.0-beta11] Wear watchfaces do not open
symptom: When trying to select some AAPS watchfaces, they typically do not open but are closed or crashed and only grey display with time is shown. In earlier beta versions (at least in 3.0-beta8) watchfaces work normally.
cause: The issue was caused by a bug related to the 'Complaint' (COB) selection on a watchface (3100 Crucial) that was not working (Issue #1123) and showed only '-'. When this Complaint selection was turned off, all AAPS watchfaces started to work. The bug disturbed AAPS watchfaces when a watchface tried to read AAPS Complaints.
fix: The fix was implemented in a commit: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/fd814baa601f954baf5d251a4959f744598fa791. The user also found a workaround: turning off the 'Complaint' selection on the problematic watchface.
settings_changed: Complaint selection on 3100 Crucial watchface → off
